person_updates.identity_evidence: The indexed Willy Dorchain has no rank or protected identifier. A 1950 Justice Department FARA report names Willy Jules Polidore Dorchain under federation registration 212, but the 1943-44 report's original printed pages 353-354 name the organization and other officers, not Dorchain. The same-person and employment chronology are not yet established.
person_updates.next_action: Inspect Box 194 for full name and OSS entry date; then compare the original FARA registration 212 filings and dated International Transport Workers' Federation records. Do not date Dorchain's federation work from the organization's 1943 registration.

research_attempts.query_text: Willy Dorchain indexed Box 194; DOJ FARA reports 1942-44 and 1945-49; International Transport Workers' Federation chronology.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: The federation's 1943 FARA registration is organizational and its named principal officers are Becu and Brier, not Dorchain; it cannot date Dorchain's own employment. Postwar union and UN records cannot by themselves establish a pre-OSS role.
research_attempts.research_notes: The rendered 1943-44 DOJ report, June 1945, https://www.justice.gov/nsd-fara/page/file/991971/dl?inline=, printed pp. 353-354/PDF pp. 356-357, lists registration 212 filed 1943-09-30 but not Dorchain. The DOJ June 1950 report, https://www.justice.gov/nsd-fara/page/file/991961/dl, index p. 173/PDF p. 174, names Willy Jules Polidore Dorchain under registration 212 during a report covering 1945-49. The visually reviewed NARA index p. 122 row 18 has Willy Dorchain, Box 194. Identity and pre-OSS sequence remain unproved.
research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 194 and original registration supplements for personal dates; do not publish the federation as a pre-OSS employer yet.

research_attempts.query_text: Alexis Doster Jr. indexed Box 195; exact-name OSS, Army airborne pickup, and Colt experimental-work leads.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A genealogy PDF mentioning experimental work at Colt timed out and could not be inspected; a search excerpt cannot establish employment. Museum and contemporary-news search excerpts concern an Army experiment, not a named civilian employer or the OSS entry date.
research_attempts.research_notes: The NARA index p. 122 row 41 was visually verified. Potential follow-ups are the Smithsonian aircraft record https://www.si.edu/object/nasm_A19500076000 and The Doster Genealogy https://www.seekingmyroots.com/members/files/G001821.pdf, neither accepted here as employer evidence. No Colt employment or immediate affiliation claim is published.
